:
The grievance of the petitioner is that respondent Nos.2 and 3 gave marking to the shops bearing door Nos.15/262, 15/263 and 15/261 in survey No.510/A, Mydukur Road, SRSJ Proddatur Town, YSR District, without issuing any notice and are taking steps to demolish the structure.
2. Heard learned counsel on either side.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that without following the procedure mandated under Section 174 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act 1965 (for short the 'Act') or The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
the authorities came to the subject property on 15.11.2023 and attempted to demolish the structures.

sentences.text: Learned standing counsel, on instructions of Commissioner of respondent No.2 would submit that road widening process is being undertaken and the authorities gave markings.
He would further submit that authorities are not demolishing the structures.
The authorities will issue notice and follow due process in accordance with the Act.

5. In view of the instructions of the Commissioner of respondent No.2, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage SRSJ of admission, directing the authorities to follow the procedure contemplated under the Act, i.e. issuing notice, considering explanation, if necessary, by providing opportunity of hearing etc., before demolishing the structures bearing door Nos.15/262, 15/263 and 15/261 in survey No.510/A, Mydukur Road, Proddatur Town, YSR District.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
